fusions.name: Itching Nip
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bounding Plague
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto your target, and the swarm bursts out around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Sixfold Spring
fusions.desc: Launches you 5 tiles forward. For 3 seconds after, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Landing Feed
fusions.desc: After you cover ground, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
